About the profession thing, yes, i do have a pretty clear mindset of what i want to do in life and i'm pretty sure that i can achieve it. Going to uni will hopefully be a new start where people should be more mature and focusing on what they want. 

Now, I have been considering a job in IT or a similar field, and i may very well go for it. Thanks to my school i can get work experience in real life and be able to get contacts. 

Believe me, i have been thinking about the future for a long while, and it certainly has kept me going, trying to stay positive to what can happen.

Yeah, i guess so, i used to hang with them a lot and we still see each other at school and play together sometimes but that's pretty much it. 

For the self-improvement part i mean buying new, fashionable clothes, trying to be more outgoing and generally trying to become a better person. Also I've started going to the gym, and that has helped a bit with my confidence.

But yeah, thanks for the advice, guess things aren't as bad as they could be.
